answer_1.quote: We implement the proposed approach based on Transformer and evaluate it on WMT14 English to German (En→De), WMT17 Chinese to English (Zh→En) and WMT16 English to Romania (En→Ro) machine translation tasks.

answer_2.quote: We use the sacreBLEU to calculate case-sensitive BLEU as the automatic metric.

answer_4.quote: We sample 100 sentences from the Zh→En test set, and invite a professional translator to label errors contained in these translations. The translation quality is divided into 5 levels and give score 1 to 5 (larger is better) and a professional translator is invited to score them.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators label error types (e.g., Omission, Addition) with severity degrees and assign overall quality scores from 1 to 5.
